raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Reconditioning Block Post-Illness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild strength to pre-illness levels"

PHASES
  PHASE "Reconditioning" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Re-entry":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Re-entry":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Re-entry":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60s
          cat_cow 60s
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hamstring_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Build":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60s
          tricep_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body Build":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 60s
          child_pose 60s
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Body Rebuild":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          figure_four_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper Body Rebuild":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body Rebuild":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60s
          spinal_twist 60s
